description: This file defines a static class 'Slug' with an extension method 'GenerateSlug' for creating URL-friendly slugs from input strings. It utilizes regular expressions to clean and format the input string by removing invalid characters, collapsing whitespace, trimming length, and replacing spaces with hyphens.

classes.name: Slug
classes.description: A static class providing a method to generate URL slugs from strings.

methods.name: GenerateSlug
methods.description: Extension method that converts a string into a URL-friendly slug by removing invalid characters, normalizing whitespace, trimming length, and replacing spaces with hyphens.

methods.name: InvalidCharsRegex
methods.description: A regex that matches characters invalid in a slug, used for removal.

methods.name: MultipleSpacesRegex
methods.description: A regex that matches multiple whitespace characters, used to condense whitespace to a single space.

methods.name: TrimRegex
methods.description: A regex that matches whitespace characters to be replaced with hyphens.
